title: Beyond detection: how students use—and hide—AI in online assessments and what authentic tasks can do about it
core_idea: A focused case study investigating how students use and conceal AI tools in online assessments, how ethical concerns shape their behaviour and disclosure, and exploring assessment-design responses—particularly authentic, data-based tasks, clear guidance, and regulation—to address AI use in higher education.
tldr: Investigates student use and nondisclosure of AI in online assessments and considers authentic assessment design and clear guidance as alternatives to detection-focused approaches.
